section_description: Choose your depth of engagement based on your leadership journey and transformation goals

executive_courage.title: Executive Courage
executive_courage.subtitle: C-Suite & Senior Leadership
executive_courage.description: For executives who need to make bold decisions in uncertain times. Develop the courage to lead through complexity while maintaining authentic relationships.
executive_courage.focus: Strategic vision, stakeholder alignment, decision-making under uncertainty
executive_courage.format: Monthly 1:1 intensive sessions + quarterly leadership retreats
outcomes: Clear strategic vision aligned with personal values

technical_bridge.title: Technical Co-Creation
technical_bridge.subtitle: Engineering & Product Leadership
technical_bridge.description: Bridge the gap between technical excellence and human-centered innovation. Learn to translate vision into executable strategy.
technical_bridge.focus: Technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, innovation frameworks

learning_culture.title: Learning-Oriented Culture
learning_culture.subtitle: Organizational Development
learning_culture.description: Create environments where continuous learning and adaptation become natural. Foster psychological safety and creative collaboration.
learning_culture.focus: Culture design, team dynamics, organizational learning systems

paracosm_retreat.title: Paracosm Executive Retreat
paracosm_retreat.subtitle: 3-Day Transformational Experience
paracosm_retreat.description: An immersive retreat blending storytelling, ritual, and mathematical creativity to spark innovation and deep reflection for senior executives.
paracosm_retreat.focus: Personal transformation, creative leadership, systems thinking through embodied practices
paracosm_retreat.format: 3-day intensive retreat with follow-up integration sessions
outcomes: Renewed sense of purpose and vision
Deep community connections with peer leaders
Integration of analytical and intuitive leadership approaches

cta.title: Ready to Begin Your Leadership Journey?
cta.description: Each residence level is designed to meet you where you are and support your unique path to transformational leadership.
